gloss: clear soup bowl; lacquered soup bowl

definitions.gloss: clear soup bowl; lacquered soup bowl
definitions.explanation: A lidded lacquered bowl used for serving Japanese clear soup ({吸|す}い{物|もの}). Typically smaller and more decorative than a rice bowl, often featuring elegant designs.

examples.english: I opened the lid of the soup bowl.

examples.japanese: {漆塗|うるしぬ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吸|す}い{物|もの}{椀|わん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use lacquered clear soup bowls.

examples.japanese: {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{吸|す}い{物|もの}{椀|わん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}される→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: At a kaiseki meal, soup bowls suited to the season are served.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧ (clear soup) + ⟦{椀|わん}→椀：00419_wan⟧ (bowl). The bowl is traditionally lacquered wood, with a fitted lid that traps the soup's aroma.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吸|す}い{物|もの}{椀|わん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧: lid of the soup bowl
- {漆塗|うるしぬ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吸|す}い{物|もの}{椀|わん}: lacquered soup bowl
- {吸|す}い{物|もの}{椀|わん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to serve in soup bowls

CULTURAL NOTE:
In formal Japanese meals such as ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧ or ⟦{会席|かいせき}→会席：11648_kaiseki⟧, the soup bowl is presented with the lid on; the diner removes it to reveal a carefully arranged broth. Designs often reflect the season.
